claims.text: DR1 NPU is described as PS-side HardNPU plus PL-side SoftNPU working together.
The document names convert_tool and al_ai_flow; the documented outputs are rt.bin and weight.bin.
A bitstream containing the required SoftNPU operators is required before runtime inference.
The runtime release package is described as include, lib, and linux_driver; the library is named npu_runtime in the application-link example.
The documented driver preparation builds hard_npu.ko, soft_npu.ko, and cma_mem.ko and then uses insmod; corresponding device nodes are expected.
The runtime reference-design list contains a yolo one-shot example including YUV-to-RGB, resize, neural-network execution, and result retrieval.
The documented flow includes npu_driver_init, npu_intr_init, npu_mem_init, load_model(rt.bin, weight.bin), input configuration/tensor access, run_graph, output access, and teardown.
Typical supported networks include yolov3-tiny, yolov3, yolov4, yolov5s, and mobilefacenet; int8/uint8 quantization is described.
The example invokes a Docker image named anlogic/nn_compiler:tag_id for host-side conversion and flow generation.
Video NPU IP is described as a PL-side IP containing SoftNPU, CSC, and Resize.
The document names target device DR1M90GEG484-2 and software TD5.9.1 Beta1.0 for its IP resource example.
The listed networks include Yolov3-tiny, Yolov3, Yolov4, Yolov5s, and Mobilefacenet with int8/uint8 support.

facts: D20.1 explicitly describes generating an HPF/bitstream, setting ANLOGIC_HPF and ANLOGIC_EXTRA_ROOTFS_DIR, enabling hard_npu_driver, soft_npu_driver and cma_mem_driver, building app/npu, and building an SD image.
D20.1 names buildroot/configs/anlogic_dr1m90_defconfig but its runnable SD example and TD archive are explicitly for AD101V20; exact MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 compatibility is UNKNOWN.
D20.0 documents NPUExecutor, quantization and CMA buffer APIs but does not state a standalone npu_runtime version or ABI matrix.
D20.3 describes a DR1M90 USB-camera/HDMI NPU example using AD101V20 as the example board and references an external SDK repository; that repository was not fetched in this allowlisted audit.
The APUG1205 and IPUG166 Wiki pages add architecture and IP facts, but do not expose a current-board .ko, npu_runtime package, official rt.bin/weight.bin pair or converter executable.
